scope: 4096 fresh independent180x180 loop80 mazes, three unchanged fixed BP/LP model seeds. Four reported arms: BP AdamW native, LP96, numerical-only LP96-to-actual-BP fallback, and the same fallback with an additional original-LP certificate requirement. Ten internal/final states retained (eight H2bh states plus two hybrid mappings). No parameter fitting or policy retuning.

inputs.independent_unit: Maze; joint success requires all three fixed models, not a union or three independent trials.
inputs.registry: Before freeze, verify proposed base seed unused, reserve it and hash all prior Work dataset manifests. Before evaluation, independently validate all shortest labels, distinctness and zero overlap with every hash-verified registered prior dataset. No replacement after outcomes.

frozen_policy.lp: Exactly H2bh LP96,256-cell candidate limit, unchanged eight-state pipeline, no extra cycle rounds.
frozen_policy.route: Per model-input, accept LP96 iff hidden_good,finite,stopped,no native cap,no block cap,and finite original LP minimum flip margin>=-1e-6. Only these numerical fields enter selection. No labels, shortest distances, graph-feasibility validation, outcome flags,input identifiers or cross-model voting.
frozen_policy.fallback: Each nonempty rejected subset within the original32-input batch executes BP native float32 u3/eta0.5/cap8192/check16 with cached identical shared float32 hidden couplings. BP all-input control executes independently in its original32-input batch. Never substitute its archived/control answer for the actual subset replay.
frozen_policy.main_acceptance: Accepted LP output is unchanged. Routed BP output requires converged original shared hidden state,finite/stopped BP flags and its own finite original float64 margin>=-1e-6. All unresolved or wrong-certified outputs remain failures in the full denominator.
frozen_policy.strict_acceptance: Same boards and routing, additionally require each routed BP board's original LP margin>=-1e-6. Report BP and LP model provenance and separate own/dual-certificate flags. Local certificates do not prove graph validity, shortestness or global optimality.
frozen_policy.no_hidden_changes: Same model checkpoints, shared hidden tol1e-6/cap4000/check8, existing native and graph solver parameters. No third fallback, extra budget, graph repair or training.

endpoints.decision: Separately one-sided95% exact CP success bounds at alpha0.05. Support if lower>=0.999, falsify if upper<0.999, otherwise inconclusive.
Same separately one-sided95% CP rule, separate endpoint; do not substitute for main hybrid.

endpoints.claim: Main hybrid joint success minus BP joint success>=-0.1percentage point
endpoints.decision: Paired gain/loss marginal CP tail alpha0.025 each for separately one-sided95% net bounds. Support if lower>=-0.1pp, falsify if upper<-0.1pp, otherwise inconclusive. No familywise95% claim.

endpoints.claim: Main hybrid added charged answer cost versus LP96<=10%
endpoints.decision: One complete fixed-cohort measured sum across both workers,100*(hybrid_charged-LP96_charged)/LP96_charged<=10 supports, otherwise falsifies. No timing confidence interval or hardware-general claim. Strict dual cost reported separately with same fixed10% descriptive threshold.

timing.baseline: LP96 pays its complete H2bh answer dependency chain and own final CPU board/counter/flag return, exactly as the previous confirmation.
timing.incremental: All original LP routing-margin computation, finite/cap predicate and CPU/device transfers, rejected-index construction, gather/setup, actual BP subset initialization/solve/CPU return, own BP margin computation and acceptance, final hybrid mapping/copy and output provenance flags are charged. The strict arm additionally pays original-LP margin verification on routed BP boards and strict flags. Shared prefixes execute once, but every logical arm pays all dependencies.
timing.bp_loading: Record additional BP model-load time separately and include it once per GPU worker in the primary hybrid numerator, even if loading eagerly serves the all-input BP control. LP baseline does not receive BP all-input-control solve costs. Do not claim deployment cost by omitting mandatory fallback model loading.
timing.controls: BP/native all-input control execution balanced with LP top-level order across jobs/batches. Actual fallback may execute only after its LP parent and never reuses the BP control output. Retain and report any fresh full-batch/subset differences; no assuming equality from source gates.
timing.excluded_reported: Dataset reading,generation,model-independent warmup,reference comparisons,non-routing diagnostics,full traces,lossless archiving and audits are outside charged answer cost but included in worker wall budgets. Report shared token/hidden work and all model loads separately; no service latency claim.

gates_before_fresh_draws.numerical: Protocol-bound source gate reproduces all H2bh shard00 inputs/all3models across all eight states plus original cap case4078/all3models. Recheck H2bj full32-batch and singleton BP parity, routing decisions and both original-model margins. Match all boards,iterations,flags,logits,candidate/trace states and cost choices; fail closed on implementation mismatch.
gates_before_fresh_draws.statistics: Independent SciPy boundary checks for both absolute decisions and BP paired NI at stated alpha before freeze.
gates_before_fresh_draws.archive_writer: Reuse H2bi bounded2-thread/2-pending lossless writer unchanged where eligible, with owning copies and full error propagation/join. Source gate proves complete scientific file/payload parity before fresh runs. Never reduce diagnostic or trace evidence to save time.

budgets.failure: Preserve all completed/partial results; no posthoc sample reduction,rerun,cap extension or target change.

schedule: Alternate16shards over WorkGPU0/GPU1, three model seeds per shard,32-input batches. Keep both GPUs productive with independent shard/model jobs. Overlap input validation and immutable completed-job audits with remaining inference when dependencies allow. Record live GPU UUID/PID/utilization and advancing job/batch counters.
independent_verification: All4096inputs and12288model-inputs remain. Audit all eight original prefix states and every candidate cost/native/terminal transition with existing independent direct-factor machinery; verify both hybrid maps by identity on accepted cases and independently evaluate every actual routed board under both BP and LP original objectives. Verify all controls,all wrong-certified accepted LP outputs,all BP failures,all caps/nonfinite states and every actual subset/control difference. Publish a fixed index-based public subset plus all routed/failure cases separately,complete per-input/model/run tables and timing receipts. Reference labels used only for generation checks and post-output evaluation.
accounting: Four reported arms add48paired source jobs and49152logical primary model-maze-arm evaluations. Internal prefixes,source gates,timing checks and identity reuse remain separately labelled. Actual fallback trajectories,source gate trajectories,and reused logical states are reported explicitly; no pooling with H2bh/H2bj. H2bh remains independently inconclusive regardless of this new result.
